 ## MVP JSX Transpiler in C++ — Summary

### What It Is
Source-to-source transpiler: **JSX** → **JS with `React.createElement` calls**. No source maps, no compiler optimizations, no Svelte-level complexity.

### Core Architecture

| Component | Responsibility |
|-----------|---------------|
| **Lexer** | Tokenize JS + JSX tokens. Handle context: `<` is "less than" in statements, JSX opener in expressions |
| **Parser** | Recursive descent. JS grammar with JSX branches in expression contexts. Stack (call stack) validates tag nesting |
| **AST** | JS nodes + JSX nodes (`JSXElement`, `JSXFragment`, `JSXAttribute`, `JSXExpressionContainer`, `JSXText`) |
| **CodeGen** | Walk AST, emit `React.createElement(tag, props, ...children)` |

### Key Parsing Rule
`<` starts JSX **only** in expression contexts (after `return`, `=`, `(`, in function args, etc.). In statement/operator contexts, it's the relational operator.

### Tag Matching
Recursive descent implicitly uses the **call stack** as your validation "box." Opening tag → recurse → closing tag must match. No separate stack needed unless you go iterative.

### Two Input Patterns, Same Output
```jsx
// Both parse identically — JSX only appears inside expression positions
export default function Home() { return (<Tags></Tags>); }
let Home = () => { return (<Tags></Tags>); }
```

### MVP Scope
- Opening/closing/self-closing tags
- Attributes: string literals, `{expressions}`, spread `...obj`
- Children: text, nested elements, `{expressions}`
- Fragments `<>...</>`
- Basic error messages (line/col, expected vs got)

### Time Estimate
**1–2 weeks** for working MVP. **2–3 weeks** if you want solid error diagnostics.

# =============================================================================
# Yggdrasil — JSX Transpiler
# Compiler: clang++ (C++17)
# =============================================================================

CXX      := clang++
CXXFLAGS := -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Iinclude
LDFLAGS  :=

# Directories
SRC_DIR   := src
INC_DIR   := include
BUILD_DIR := build
BIN_DIR   := bin

TARGET := $(BIN_DIR)/yggdrasil

# Collect all .cpp sources
SRCS := $(wildcard $(SRC_DIR)/*.cpp)
OBJS := $(patsubst $(SRC_DIR)/%.cpp,$(BUILD_DIR)/%.o,$(SRCS))

# Header dependencies (all headers in include/)
HEADERS := $(wildcard $(INC_DIR)/*.h)

# =============================================================================
# Targets
# =============================================================================

.PHONY: all clean release debug test help

all: $(TARGET)

# Link
$(TARGET): $(OBJS) | $(BIN_DIR)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $(LDFLAGS) -o $@ $^
	@echo "Built: $@"

# Compile each .cpp → .o
$(BUILD_DIR)/%.o: $(SRC_DIR)/%.cpp $(HEADERS) | $(BUILD_DIR)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

# Create output directories
$(BUILD_DIR):
	mkdir -p $(BUILD_DIR)

$(BIN_DIR):
	mkdir -p $(BIN_DIR)

# Debug build (no optimisation, debug symbols, sanitisers)
debug: CXXFLAGS += -g -O0 -DDEBUG -fsanitize=address,undefined
debug: LDFLAGS  += -fsanitize=address,undefined
debug: $(TARGET)

# Release build (optimised, strip debug info)
release: CXXFLAGS += -O2 -DNDEBUG
release: $(TARGET)

# Run test fixtures
test: $(TARGET)
	@echo "=== Running test fixtures ==="
	@pass=0; fail=0; \
	for jsx in tests/fixtures/*.jsx; do \
		base=$${jsx%.jsx}; \
		expected=$${base}.expected.js; \
		if [ ! -f "$$expected" ]; then continue; fi; \
		actual=$$($(TARGET) "$$jsx" 2>&1); \
		if [ "$$actual" = "$$(cat $$expected)" ]; then \
			echo "  PASS: $$jsx"; pass=$$((pass+1)); \
		else \
			echo "  FAIL: $$jsx"; \
			echo "  --- expected ---"; cat "$$expected"; \
			echo "  --- actual ---";  echo "$$actual"; \
			fail=$$((fail+1)); \
		fi; \
	done; \
	echo "Results: $$pass passed, $$fail failed"

clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD_DIR) $(BIN_DIR)

help:
	@echo "Targets:"
	@echo "  all      Build the transpiler (default)"
	@echo "  debug    Build with debug symbols and sanitisers"
	@echo "  release  Build optimised"
	@echo "  test     Run fixture tests"
	@echo "  clean    Remove build artefacts"

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Build script for Yggdrasil JSX Transpiler (Windows / PowerShell).

.DESCRIPTION
    Wraps clang++ invocations for developers who prefer PowerShell over make.
    Supports Debug, Release, and Test modes.

.PARAMETER Mode
    Build mode: Debug | Release | Clean | Test (default: Debug)

.PARAMETER Run
    After a successful build, run the transpiler with these arguments.
    Example: .\build.ps1 -Run "tests\fixtures\basic.jsx"

.EXAMPLE
    .\build.ps1
    .\build.ps1 -Mode Release
    .\build.ps1 -Mode Test
    .\build.ps1 -Mode Debug -Run "tests\fixtures\basic.jsx"
#>

param(
    [ValidateSet("Debug","Release","Clean","Test")]
    [string]$Mode = "Debug",

    [string]$Run = ""
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Paths
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$Root      = $PSScriptRoot
$SrcDir    = Join-Path $Root "src"
$IncDir    = Join-Path $Root "include"
$BuildDir  = Join-Path $Root "build"
$BinDir    = Join-Path $Root "bin"
$Target    = Join-Path $BinDir "yggdrasil.exe"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compiler settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$CXX       = "clang++"
$BaseFlags = @("-std=c++17", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Wpedantic", "-I$IncDir")

$ModeFlags = switch ($Mode) {
    "Debug"   { @("-g", "-O0", "-DDEBUG", "-fsanitize=address,undefined") }
    "Release" { @("-O2", "-DNDEBUG") }
    default   { @() }
}

$CXXFlags = $BaseFlags + $ModeFlags

$LDFlags = if ($Mode -eq "Debug") {
    @("-fsanitize=address,undefined")
} else {
    @()
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Invoke-Checked {
    param([string]$Exe, [string[]]$Args)
    Write-Host "> $Exe $($Args -join ' ')" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    & $Exe @Args
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Error "Command failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE"
    }
}

function Get-Sources {
    Get-ChildItem -Path $SrcDir -Filter "*.cpp" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clean
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Mode -eq "Clean") {
    Write-Host "Cleaning build artefacts..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    if (Test-Path $BuildDir) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $BuildDir }
    if (Test-Path $BinDir)   { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $BinDir   }
    Write-Host "Done." -ForegroundColor Green
    exit 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test (run fixture tests without rebuilding if binary exists)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Mode -eq "Test") {
    if (-not (Test-Path $Target)) {
        Write-Host "Binary not found — building first (Debug)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        & $PSCommandPath -Mode Debug
    }
    Write-Host "=== Running fixture tests ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    $pass = 0; $fail = 0
    $fixtures = Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $Root "tests\fixtures") -Filter "*.jsx" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    foreach ($jsx in $fixtures) {
        $expectedPath = [IO.Path]::ChangeExtension($jsx.FullName, ".expected.js")
        if (-not (Test-Path $expectedPath)) { continue }
        $actual   = & $Target $jsx.FullName 2>&1 | Out-String
        $expected = Get-Content $expectedPath -Raw
        if ($actual.TrimEnd() -eq $expected.TrimEnd()) {
            Write-Host "  PASS: $($jsx.Name)" -ForegroundColor Green
            $pass++
        } else {
            Write-Host "  FAIL: $($jsx.Name)" -ForegroundColor Red
            Write-Host "  -- expected --" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
            Write-Host $expected
            Write-Host "  -- actual --" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
            Write-Host $actual
            $fail++
        }
    }
    Write-Host "Results: $pass passed, $fail failed" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    exit ($fail -gt 0 ? 1 : 0)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BuildDir | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BinDir   | Out-Null

$sources = Get-Sources
$objects = @()

Write-Host "=== Compiling ($Mode) ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

foreach ($src in $sources) {
    $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($src)
    $obj  = Join-Path $BuildDir "$name.o"
    $objects += $obj
    Invoke-Checked $CXX ($CXXFlags + @("-c", "-o", $obj, $src))
}

Write-Host "=== Linking ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Invoke-Checked $CXX ($CXXFlags + $LDFlags + @("-o", $Target) + $objects)

Write-Host "Built: $Target" -ForegroundColor Green

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optional: run after build
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Run -ne "") {
    Write-Host "=== Running ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Invoke-Checked $Target @($Run)
}

    if (Test-Path $BinDir)   { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $BinDir   }
    Write-Host "Done." -ForegroundColor Green
    exit 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Mode -eq "Test") {
    if (-not (Test-Path $Target)) {
        Write-Host "Binary not found — building first (Debug)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        & $PSCommandPath -Mode Debug
    }
    Write-Host "=== Running fixture tests ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    $pass = 0; $fail = 0
    $fixtures = Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $Root "tests\fixtures") -Filter "*.jsx" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    foreach ($jsx in $fixtures) {

            Write-Host "  -- expected --" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow

    exit ($fail -gt 0 ? 1 : 0)

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BinDir   | Out-Null

$sources = Get-Sources
$objects = @()

    $objects += $obj
    Invoke-Checked $CXX ($CXXFlags + @("-c", "-o", $obj, $src))

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Fixture test runner for Yggdrasil.

.DESCRIPTION
    Two fixture conventions are supported:
      *.jsx + *.expected.js   — transpiler output must equal the .expected.js file
      *.jsx + *.expected_exit — transpiler must exit with the code in that file (error tests)

.PARAMETER Binary
    Path to the yggdrasil binary. Defaults to bin\yggdrasil.exe relative to repo root.

.PARAMETER Filter
    Optional glob filter on fixture base names, e.g. "01_*" or "err_*".
#>
param(
    [string]$Binary = "",
    [string]$Filter = "*"
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$RepoRoot    = Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..\..") | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Path
$FixturesDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot "tests\fixtures"

if ($Binary -eq "") {
    $Binary = Join-Path $RepoRoot "bin\yggdrasil.exe"
}

if (-not (Test-Path $Binary)) {
    Write-Error "Binary not found: $Binary`nBuild first with: .\build.ps1"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ANSI colour helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Green  { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Green  -NoNewline }
function Red    { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Red    -NoNewline }
function Yellow { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Yellow -NoNewline }
function Cyan   { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Cyan   -NoNewline }
function Nl     { Write-Host "" }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Diff helper — show first divergence
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Show-Diff {
    param([string]$Expected, [string]$Actual)
    $expLines = $Expected -split "`n"
    $actLines = $Actual   -split "`n"
    $max = [Math]::Max($expLines.Count, $actLines.Count)
    $shown = 0
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $max -and $shown -lt 8; $i++) {
        $e = if ($i -lt $expLines.Count) { $expLines[$i] } else { "<missing>" }
        $a = if ($i -lt $actLines.Count) { $actLines[$i] } else { "<missing>" }
        if ($e -ne $a) {
            Yellow "    line $($i+1):`n"; Nl
            Green  "      expected: $e"; Nl
            Red    "      actual  : $a"; Nl
            $shown++
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Collect fixtures
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$jsxFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $FixturesDir -Filter "$Filter.jsx" |
            Where-Object { $_.Name -notmatch "^err_" -or $_.Name -match "^err_" } |
            Sort-Object Name

$pass = 0
$fail = 0
$skip = 0

Write-Host ""
Cyan "=== Yggdrasil Fixture Tests ==="; Nl
Write-Host "  Binary  : $Binary"
Write-Host "  Fixtures: $FixturesDir"
Write-Host "  Filter  : $Filter"
Write-Host ""

foreach ($jsx in $jsxFiles) {
    $base        = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($jsx.FullName)
    $expectedJs  = Join-Path $FixturesDir "$base.expected.js"
    $expectedExit= Join-Path $FixturesDir "$base.expected_exit"

    # ---- Error-exit test ----
    if (Test-Path $expectedExit) {
        $wantExit = (Get-Content $expectedExit -Raw).Trim()
        $output   = & $Binary $jsx.FullName 2>&1
        $gotExit  = $LASTEXITCODE
        if ([string]$gotExit -eq $wantExit) {
            Green "  PASS"; Write-Host " [exit=$gotExit] $($jsx.Name)"
            $pass++
        } else {
            Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " [exit=$gotExit, want=$wantExit] $($jsx.Name)"
            $fail++
        }
        continue
    }

    # ---- Output comparison test ----
    if (-not (Test-Path $expectedJs)) {
        Yellow "  SKIP"; Write-Host " (no .expected.js) $($jsx.Name)"
        $skip++
        continue
    }

    $expected = (Get-Content $expectedJs -Raw).TrimEnd()
    $actual   = (& $Binary $jsx.FullName 2>&1 | Out-String).TrimEnd()
    $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

    if ($exitCode -ne 0) {
        Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " [exit=$exitCode] $($jsx.Name)"
        Write-Host "    stderr: $actual"
        $fail++
        continue
    }

    if ($actual -eq $expected) {
        Green "  PASS"; Write-Host " $($jsx.Name)"
        $pass++
    } else {
        Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " $($jsx.Name)"
        Show-Diff $expected $actual
        $fail++
    }
}

Write-Host ""
Cyan "Results: "; Nl
Green  "  $pass passed"; Nl
if ($fail -gt 0)  { Red    "  $fail failed"; Nl }
if ($skip -gt 0)  { Yellow "  $skip skipped"; Nl }
Write-Host ""

exit ($fail -gt 0 ? 1 : 0)

    # ---- Error-exit test ----
    if (Test-Path $expectedExit) {
        $wantExit = (Get-Content $expectedExit -Raw).Trim()
        $output   = & $Binary $jsx.FullName 2>&1
        $gotExit  = $LASTEXITCODE
        if ([string]$gotExit -eq $wantExit) {
            Green "  PASS"; Write-Host " [exit=$gotExit] $($jsx.Name)"
            $pass++
        } else {
            Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " [exit=$gotExit, want=$wantExit] $($jsx.Name)"
            $fail++
        }
        continue
    }

    # ---- Output comparison test ----
    if (-not (Test-Path $expectedJs)) {
        Yellow "  SKIP"; Write-Host " (no .expected.js) $($jsx.Name)"
        $skip++
        continue
    }

    $expected = (Get-Content $expectedJs -Raw).TrimEnd()
    $actual   = (& $Binary $jsx.FullName 2>&1 | Out-String).TrimEnd()
    $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

    if ($exitCode -ne 0) {
        Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " [exit=$exitCode] $($jsx.Name)"
        Write-Host "    stderr: $actual"
        $fail++
        continue
    }

    if ($actual -eq $expected) {
        Green "  PASS"; Write-Host " $($jsx.Name)"
        $pass++
    } else {
        Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " $($jsx.Name)"
        Show-Diff $expected $actual
        $fail++
    }
}

Write-Host ""
Cyan "Results: "; Nl
Green  "  $pass passed"; Nl
if ($fail -gt 0)  { Red    "  $fail failed"; Nl }
if ($skip -gt 0)  { Yellow "  $skip skipped"; Nl }
Write-Host ""

exit ($fail -gt 0 ? 1 : 0)

.SYNOPSIS

.DESCRIPTION

    Supports Debug, Release, and Test modes.

.PARAMETER Mode
    Build mode: Debug | Release | Clean | Test (default: Debug)

.PARAMETER Run
    After a successful build, run the transpiler with these arguments.
    Example: .\build.ps1 -Run "tests\fixtures\basic.jsx"

.EXAMPLE
    .\build.ps1
    .\build.ps1 -Mode Release
    .\build.ps1 -Mode Test
    .\build.ps1 -Mode Debug -Run "tests\fixtures\basic.jsx"
#>

param(
    [ValidateSet("Debug","Release","Clean","Test")]
    [string]$Mode = "Debug",

    [string]$Run = ""
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Paths
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$Root      = $PSScriptRoot
$SrcDir    = Join-Path $Root "src"
$IncDir    = Join-Path $Root "include"
$BuildDir  = Join-Path $Root "build"
$BinDir    = Join-Path $Root "bin"
$Target    = Join-Path $BinDir "yggdrasil.exe"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compiler settings
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$CXX       = "clang++"
$BaseFlags = @("-std=c++17", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Wpedantic", "-I$IncDir")

$ModeFlags = switch ($Mode) {
    "Debug"   { @("-g", "-O0", "-DDEBUG", "-fsanitize=address,undefined") }
    "Release" { @("-O2", "-DNDEBUG") }
    default   { @() }
}

$CXXFlags = $BaseFlags + $ModeFlags

$LDFlags = if ($Mode -eq "Debug") {
    @("-fsanitize=address,undefined")
} else {
    @()
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Invoke-Checked {
    param([string]$Exe, [string[]]$Args)
    Write-Host "> $Exe $($Args -join ' ')" -ForegroundColor DarkGray
    & $Exe @Args
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        Write-Error "Command failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE"
    }
}

function Get-Sources {
    Get-ChildItem -Path $SrcDir -Filter "*.cpp" | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clean
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Mode -eq "Clean") {
    Write-Host "Cleaning build artefacts..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    if (Test-Path $BuildDir) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $BuildDir }
    if (Test-Path $BinDir)   { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $BinDir   }
    Write-Host "Done." -ForegroundColor Green
    exit 0
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test (run fixture tests without rebuilding if binary exists)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Mode -eq "Test") {
    if (-not (Test-Path $Target)) {
        Write-Host "Binary not found — building first (Debug)..." -ForegroundColor Yellow
        & $PSCommandPath -Mode Debug
    }
    Write-Host "=== Running fixture tests ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    $pass = 0; $fail = 0
    $fixtures = Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $Root "tests\fixtures") -Filter "*.jsx" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    foreach ($jsx in $fixtures) {
        $expectedPath = [IO.Path]::ChangeExtension($jsx.FullName, ".expected.js")
        if (-not (Test-Path $expectedPath)) { continue }
        $actual   = & $Target $jsx.FullName 2>&1 | Out-String
        $expected = Get-Content $expectedPath -Raw
        if ($actual.TrimEnd() -eq $expected.TrimEnd()) {
            Write-Host "  PASS: $($jsx.Name)" -ForegroundColor Green
            $pass++
        } else {
            Write-Host "  FAIL: $($jsx.Name)" -ForegroundColor Red
            Write-Host "  -- expected --" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
            Write-Host $expected
            Write-Host "  -- actual --" -ForegroundColor DarkYellow
            Write-Host $actual
            $fail++
        }
    }
    Write-Host "Results: $pass passed, $fail failed" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    exit ($fail -gt 0 ? 1 : 0)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BuildDir | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $BinDir   | Out-Null

$sources = Get-Sources
$objects = @()

Write-Host "=== Compiling ($Mode) ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan

foreach ($src in $sources) {
    $name = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($src)
    $obj  = Join-Path $BuildDir "$name.o"
    $objects += $obj
    Invoke-Checked $CXX ($CXXFlags + @("-c", "-o", $obj, $src))
}

Write-Host "=== Linking ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Invoke-Checked $CXX ($CXXFlags + $LDFlags + @("-o", $Target) + $objects)

Write-Host "Built: $Target" -ForegroundColor Green

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Optional: run after build
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ($Run -ne "") {
    Write-Host "=== Running ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
    Invoke-Checked $Target @($Run)
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Fixture test runner for Yggdrasil.

.DESCRIPTION
    Two fixture conventions are supported:
      *.jsx + *.expected.js   — transpiler output must equal the .expected.js file
      *.jsx + *.expected_exit — transpiler must exit with the code in that file (error tests)

.PARAMETER Binary
    Path to the yggdrasil binary. Defaults to bin\yggdrasil.exe relative to repo root.

.PARAMETER Filter
    Optional glob filter on fixture base names, e.g. "01_*" or "err_*".
#>
param(
    [string]$Binary = "",
    [string]$Filter = "*"
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$RepoRoot    = Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..\..") | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Path
$FixturesDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot "tests\fixtures"

if ($Binary -eq "") {
    $Binary = Join-Path $RepoRoot "bin\yggdrasil.exe"
}

if (-not (Test-Path $Binary)) {
    Write-Error "Binary not found: $Binary`nBuild first with: .\build.ps1"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ANSI colour helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Green  { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Green  -NoNewline }
function Red    { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Red    -NoNewline }
function Yellow { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Yellow -NoNewline }
function Cyan   { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Cyan   -NoNewline }
function Nl     { Write-Host "" }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Diff helper — show first divergence
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Show-Diff {
    param([string]$Expected, [string]$Actual)
    $expLines = $Expected -split "`n"
    $actLines = $Actual   -split "`n"
    $max = [Math]::Max($expLines.Count, $actLines.Count)
    $shown = 0
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $max -and $shown -lt 8; $i++) {
        $e = if ($i -lt $expLines.Count) { $expLines[$i] } else { "<missing>" }
        $a = if ($i -lt $actLines.Count) { $actLines[$i] } else { "<missing>" }
        if ($e -ne $a) {
            Yellow "    line $($i+1):`n"; Nl
            Green  "      expected: $e"; Nl
            Red    "      actual  : $a"; Nl
            $shown++
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Collect fixtures
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$jsxFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $FixturesDir -Filter "$Filter.jsx" |
            Where-Object { $_.Name -notmatch "^err_" -or $_.Name -match "^err_" } |
            Sort-Object Name

$pass = 0
$fail = 0
$skip = 0

Write-Host ""
Cyan "=== Yggdrasil Fixture Tests ==="; Nl
Write-Host "  Binary  : $Binary"
Write-Host "  Fixtures: $FixturesDir"
Write-Host "  Filter  : $Filter"
Write-Host ""

foreach ($jsx in $jsxFiles) {
    $base        = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($jsx.FullName)
    $expectedJs  = Join-Path $FixturesDir "$base.expected.js"
    $expectedExit= Join-Path $FixturesDir "$base.expected_exit"

# =============================================================================
# Yggdrasil — JSX Transpiler
# Compiler: clang++ (C++17)
# =============================================================================

CXX      := clang++
CXXFLAGS := -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Iinclude
LDFLAGS  :=

# Directories
SRC_DIR   := src
INC_DIR   := include
BUILD_DIR := build
BIN_DIR   := bin

TARGET := $(BIN_DIR)/yggdrasil

# Collect all .cpp sources
SRCS := $(wildcard $(SRC_DIR)/*.cpp)
OBJS := $(patsubst $(SRC_DIR)/%.cpp,$(BUILD_DIR)/%.o,$(SRCS))

# Header dependencies (all headers in include/)
HEADERS := $(wildcard $(INC_DIR)/*.h)

# =============================================================================
# Targets
# =============================================================================

.PHONY: all clean release debug test help

all: $(TARGET)

# Link
$(TARGET): $(OBJS) | $(BIN_DIR)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $(LDFLAGS) -o $@ $^
	@echo "Built: $@"

# Compile each .cpp → .o
$(BUILD_DIR)/%.o: $(SRC_DIR)/%.cpp $(HEADERS) | $(BUILD_DIR)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

# Create output directories
$(BUILD_DIR):
	mkdir -p $(BUILD_DIR)

$(BIN_DIR):
	mkdir -p $(BIN_DIR)

# Debug build (no optimisation, debug symbols, sanitisers)
debug: CXXFLAGS += -g -O0 -DDEBUG -fsanitize=address,undefined
debug: LDFLAGS  += -fsanitize=address,undefined
debug: $(TARGET)

# Release build (optimised, strip debug info)
release: CXXFLAGS += -O2 -DNDEBUG
release: $(TARGET)

# Run test fixtures
test: $(TARGET)
	@echo "=== Running test fixtures ==="
	@pass=0; fail=0; \
	for jsx in tests/fixtures/*.jsx; do \
		base=$${jsx%.jsx}; \
		expected=$${base}.expected.js; \
		if [ ! -f "$$expected" ]; then continue; fi; \
		actual=$$($(TARGET) "$$jsx" 2>&1); \
		if [ "$$actual" = "$$(cat $$expected)" ]; then \
			echo "  PASS: $$jsx"; pass=$$((pass+1)); \
		else \
			echo "  FAIL: $$jsx"; \
			echo "  --- expected ---"; cat "$$expected"; \
			echo "  --- actual ---";  echo "$$actual"; \
			fail=$$((fail+1)); \
		fi; \
	done; \
	echo "Results: $$pass passed, $$fail failed"

clean:
	rm -rf $(BUILD_DIR) $(BIN_DIR)

help:
	@echo "Targets:"
	@echo "  all      Build the transpiler (default)"
	@echo "  debug    Build with debug symbols and sanitisers"
	@echo "  release  Build optimised"
	@echo "  test     Run fixture tests"
	@echo "  clean    Remove build artefacts"

LDFLAGS  :=

BIN_DIR   := bin

ifeq ($(OS),Windows_NT)
    PLATFORM      := windows
    TARGET        := $(BIN_DIR)/yggdrasil.exe
    RM_RF         := rmdir /s /q
    MKDIR         = if not exist "$@" mkdir "$@"
    DEVNULL       := nul
    # PowerShell available everywhere on modern Windows
    TEST_CMD      := powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass \
                     -File tests\runner\run_tests.ps1 -Binary $(TARGET)
    PATHSEP       := \\

    PLATFORM      := unix

.PHONY: all clean release debug test help

all: $(TARGET)

# Link
$(TARGET): $(OBJS) | $(BIN_DIR)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $(LDFLAGS) -o $@ $^
	@echo "Built: $@"

# Compile each .cpp → .o
$(BUILD_DIR)/%.o: $(SRC_DIR)/%.cpp $(HEADERS) | $(BUILD_DIR)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

# Create output directories
$(BUILD_DIR):
	if not exist $(BUILD_DIR) mkdir $(BUILD_DIR)

$(BIN_DIR):
	if not exist $(BIN_DIR) mkdir $(BIN_DIR)

# Debug build (no optimisation, debug symbols, sanitisers)
debug: CXXFLAGS += -g -O0 -DDEBUG -fsanitize=address,undefined
debug: LDFLAGS  += -fsanitize=address,undefined
debug: $(TARGET)

# Release build (optimised, strip debug info)
release: CXXFLAGS += -O2 -DNDEBUG
release: $(TARGET)

# Run test fixtures — delegate to the PowerShell runner (works on Windows cmd)
test: $(TARGET)
	powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests\runner\run_tests.ps1 -Binary $(TARGET)

clean:
	if exist $(BUILD_DIR) rmdir /s /q $(BUILD_DIR)
	if exist $(BIN_DIR)   rmdir /s /q $(BIN_DIR)

help:
	@echo "Targets:"
	@echo "  all      Build the transpiler (default)"
	@echo "  debug    Build with debug symbols and sanitisers"
	@echo "  release  Build optimised"
	@echo "  test     Run fixture tests"
	@echo "  clean    Remove build artefacts"

content.text: The parser is failing on `<input disabled />` — it's consuming `disabled` as the attribute name, then seeing `/` and expecting another attribute name instead of recognising `/>`. The JSX attribute loop needs to stop when it sees `/>`. Let me check the parser's attribute-scanning loop:

content.content: 736:    while (!check(TokenKind::JSXGreater) && !check(TokenKind::JSXSlashGreater) && !atEnd()) {

toolUseResult.content: 736:    while (!check(TokenKind::JSXGreater) && !check(TokenKind::JSXSlashGreater) && !atEnd()) {

content.text:
The loop condition is correct. The real problem is the lexer: when in `JSXTag` mode, it sees `/` then `>` but the `/>` compound token (`JSXSlashGreater`) is only scanned if `/` is the *first* character peeked. But after emitting `disabled` as an `Identifier`, the lexer is still in `JSXTag` mode and should see `/>` — yet the parser never pushed `JSXTag` mode onto the lexer in the first place. The parser and lexer mode stacks are never connected: the parser has `inExpressionContext_` but never calls `lexer.pushMode()`. Since tokenisation is done eagerly upfront (all tokens produced before parsing starts), the mode stack on the lexer is irrelevant at parse time — but that means the lexer had no JSX context when it scanned the tokens, so it never emitted `JSXLess`, `JSXSlashGreater` etc.

The fix: the lexer's eager `tokenize()` needs to self-manage its own mode stack as it scans — driven by the tokens it sees, not by the parser. Let me rewrite the lexer to track JSX state internally:

content.text: The problem is the `jsxAllowed()` check in `scanPunctuation`. When lexing `<input` the `<` comes after `return` (correctly JSX), but after emitting `Identifier` for `input` the mode switches to `JSXTag`. However the tokenizer is currently in `JS` mode when it sees `<` (since it hasn't pushed JSXTag yet — that only happens after the `<` is emitted). The `<` is correctly emitted as `JSXLess`, then `JSXTag` is pushed — that part is fine. The real issue is the `skipWhitespaceAndComments()` call at the top of the loop skips whitespace before checking mode, but for `JSXTag` this is fine since whitespace between attributes should be skipped. Token 64 is `Slash` and 75 is `Greater` — the lexer emitted two separate tokens instead of `JSXSlashGreater` (kind 82). The `/>` is not being recognised in JSXTag mode. The `skipWhitespaceAndComments()` call at the top of the loop runs before mode is checked, but more critically: looking at the loop — after emitting `disabled` as an Identifier, `lastKind_` is set to `Identifier`. Then on the next iteration, `currentMode()` should be `JSXTag`... but `skipWhitespaceAndComments()` is called first. Then we check `mode = currentMode()`. Let me check what mode is actually active — the issue is likely that after emitting `JSXLess`, the mode push to `JSXTag` happens but then `input` and `disabled` are scanned in `JSXTag` mode correctly. However `/` — looking at the JSXTag handler, it checks `ch == '/' && peek(1) == '>'`, but `skipWhitespaceAndComments()` is called at the *top* of the outer loop, before mode is re-read. That should be fine. Wait — the issue is the `skipWhitespaceAndComments()` call at the very top applies even in JSXTag, but then inside `JSXTag` block there's *another* `skipWhitespaceAndComments()` call. That's correct. But the space before `/>` — after eating whitespace, `peek()` should be `/`. Let me check: is `JSXTag` even being entered? Token `disabled` is kind `3` (Identifier) — that's right. But what mode is active after emitting `disabled`?

The bug: after emitting the `JSXLess` token, the code does `pushMode(JSXTag)` — but `lastKind_` is then set to `JSXLess` and `tokens.push_back()` happens, then the loop continues. On the next iteration `currentMode()` is `JSXTag` ✓. `input` is scanned correctly as Identifier in JSXTag. `disabled` too. Then on the next iteration `currentMode()` is still `JSXTag`, `skipWhitespaceAndComments()` skips the space, inner `skipWhitespaceAndComments()` runs again (harmless), `peek()` is `/`, `peek(1)` is `>` — that should match. Unless... `peek(1)` looks at `pos_+1` but the whitespace was already consumed. Let me trace: after `disabled` ends, `pos_` points at the space before `/>`. Top of loop: `skipWhitespaceAndComments()` — **this runs before mode check** and eats the space. Now `pos_` points at `/`. Mode is `JSXTag`, inner `skipWhitespaceAndComments()` runs again (noop). `ch = peek()` = `/`, `peek(1)` = `>`. That should match `ch == '/' && peek(1) == '>'`.

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Fixture test runner for Yggdrasil.

.DESCRIPTION
    Two fixture conventions are supported:
      *.jsx + *.expected.js   — transpiler output must equal the .expected.js file
      *.jsx + *.expected_exit — transpiler must exit with the code in that file (error tests)

.PARAMETER Binary
    Path to the yggdrasil binary. Defaults to bin\yggdrasil.exe relative to repo root.

.PARAMETER Filter
    Optional glob filter on fixture base names, e.g. "01_*" or "err_*".
#>
param(
    [string]$Binary = "",
    [string]$Filter = "*"
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$RepoRoot    = Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..\..") | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Path
$FixturesDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot "tests\fixtures"

if ($Binary -eq "") {
    $Binary = Join-Path $RepoRoot "bin\yggdrasil.exe"
}

if (-not (Test-Path $Binary)) {
    Write-Error "Binary not found: $Binary`nBuild first with: .\build.ps1"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ANSI colour helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Green  { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Green  -NoNewline }
function Red    { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Red    -NoNewline }
function Yellow { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Yellow -NoNewline }
function Cyan   { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Cyan   -NoNewline }
function Nl     { Write-Host "" }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Diff helper — show first divergence
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Show-Diff {
    param([string]$Expected, [string]$Actual)
    $expLines = $Expected -split "`n"
    $actLines = $Actual   -split "`n"
    $max = [Math]::Max($expLines.Count, $actLines.Count)
    $shown = 0
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $max -and $shown -lt 8; $i++) {
        $e = if ($i -lt $expLines.Count) { $expLines[$i] } else { "<missing>" }
        $a = if ($i -lt $actLines.Count) { $actLines[$i] } else { "<missing>" }
        if ($e -ne $a) {
            Yellow "    line $($i+1):`n"; Nl
            Green  "      expected: $e"; Nl
            Red    "      actual  : $a"; Nl
            $shown++
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Collect fixtures
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$jsxFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $FixturesDir -Filter "$Filter.jsx" |
            Where-Object { $_.Name -notmatch "^err_" -or $_.Name -match "^err_" } |
            Sort-Object Name

$pass = 0
$fail = 0
$skip = 0

Write-Host ""
Cyan "=== Yggdrasil Fixture Tests ==="; Nl
Write-Host "  Binary  : $Binary"
Write-Host "  Fixtures: $FixturesDir"
Write-Host "  Filter  : $Filter"
Write-Host ""

foreach ($jsx in $jsxFiles) {
    $base        = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($jsx.FullName)
    $expectedJs  = Join-Path $FixturesDir "$base.expected.js"
    $expectedExit= Join-Path $FixturesDir "$base.expected_exit"

    # ---- Error-exit test ----
    if (Test-Path $expectedExit) {
        $wantExit = (Get-Content $expectedExit -Raw).Trim()
        $output   = & $Binary $jsx.FullName 2>&1
        $gotExit  = $LASTEXITCODE
        if ([string]$gotExit -eq $wantExit) {
            Green "  PASS"; Write-Host " [exit=$gotExit] $($jsx.Name)"
            $pass++
        } else {
            Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " [exit=$gotExit, want=$wantExit] $($jsx.Name)"
            $fail++
        }
        continue
    }

    # ---- Output comparison test ----
    if (-not (Test-Path $expectedJs)) {
        Yellow "  SKIP"; Write-Host " (no .expected.js) $($jsx.Name)"
        $skip++
        continue
    }

    $expected = (Get-Content $expectedJs -Raw).TrimEnd()
    $actual   = (& $Binary $jsx.FullName 2>&1 | Out-String).TrimEnd()
    $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

    if ($exitCode -ne 0) {
        Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " [exit=$exitCode] $($jsx.Name)"
        Write-Host "    stderr: $actual"
        $fail++
        continue
    }

    if ($actual -eq $expected) {
        Green "  PASS"; Write-Host " $($jsx.Name)"
        $pass++
    } else {
        Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " $($jsx.Name)"
        Show-Diff $expected $actual
        $fail++
    }
}

Write-Host ""
Cyan "Results: "; Nl
Green  "  $pass passed"; Nl
if ($fail -gt 0)  { Red    "  $fail failed"; Nl }
if ($skip -gt 0)  { Yellow "  $skip skipped"; Nl }
Write-Host ""

if ($fail -gt 0) { exit 1 } else { exit 0 }

The JS expression `count + 1` doesn't contain `>` but the `>` that closes the `<button` tag follows the `}`. After `}` the lexer pops back to JSXTag mode, then sees `>` and emits `JSXGreater`. But the parser's `parseJSXAttribute` loop condition checks `!check(TokenKind::JSXGreater)` — let me trace more carefully. Actually fixture 05 is `<button onClick={() => count + 1}>Click</button>`. The `=>` inside the expression — after the lexer enters JS mode for the `{` expression, it scans `() => count + 1`. The `>` in `=>` is scanned in JS mode as part of `Arrow`. But then when it exits JS mode back to JSXTag, the next char is `>` which becomes `JSXGreater`. That should be fine. Let me check what actually fails:

Two problems visible in the token stream:

1. Token 75 `>` at col 43 — that's `JSXGreater` correctly emitted after `}`. Good.
2. Token 74 `<` at col 49 — that's `JSXLess` correctly. But then token 4 is `JSXText` containing `/button>;\n}\n` — the lexer entered `JSXChildren` after `>` at col 43 but then the `</button>` closing tag was scanned as JSXText because `JSXLessSlash` needs `</` but the `<` was consumed as `JSXLess`, pushing another `JSXTag` instead of recognising it as `</`.

The real problem: after `{...}` in JSXTag mode, we push JS and pop back to JSXTag. Then `JSXGreater` is emitted and we push JSXChildren. Then `Click` text is scanned fine. Then `<` is seen — we check `peek() == '/'` which is true so we emit `JSXLessSlash` and push JSXTag. That should work...

But wait — `>` at col 43 is kind 75. Let me check: `JSXGreater` is kind 81, `Greater` is kind 75. So the `>` after `}` was emitted as a plain JS `Greater` token, not `JSXGreater`. That means when `}` was processed in the JS-inside-JSXTag context, the pop went back to JS mode instead of JSXTag. The `jsxBraceDepth` pop returned to JSXChildren (the wrong parent) or the mode was wrong.

The issue: the `{` for a JSX attribute expression is in `JSXTag` mode. When we push JS for the expression and then pop back after `}`, we pop back to `JSXTag` — but then the `>` check runs in the JS branch (bottom of the loop), not the JSXTag branch, because `currentMode()` returned to JSXTag *after* the RBrace was already processed in the JS branch with `continue`. Then the next iteration should pick up `>` in JSXTag mode. Let me re-check...

Actually the token dump shows `}` at col 42 (kind 38 = `RBrace`) and `>` at col 43 (kind 75 = `Greater`). The `}` consumed the JSX brace depth and popped back to JSXTag — correct. But then on the next iteration the mode should be JSXTag and `>` should emit `JSXGreater` (kind 81). It's emitting kind 75 instead, meaning it went through the JS `scanPunctuation()` path. So either the pop didn't work or `jsxBraceDepth` tracking is wrong for attributes (JSXTag context, not JSXChildren).

The bug: `jsxBraceDepth` is pushed in JSXTag `{` handler, but the JS `}` handler only pops when `braceDepth == jsxBraceDepth.back() + 1`. The attribute `{` advances braceDepth to 1 inside JS mode — wait, no. The `{` in JSXTag pushes JS mode *before* the brace depth tracking in the JS branch runs. When `{` of `{()=>...}` is seen in JSXTag: we emit LBrace, push `jsxBraceDepth.back() = braceDepth = 0`, push JS mode. Then in JS mode, `(`, `)`, `=>`, `count`, `+`, `1` are all scanned. `braceDepth` is still 0 throughout (no `{` or `}` seen in JS yet). Then `}` is seen: `braceDepth == 0` and `jsxBraceDepth.back() + 1 == 1` — condition `braceDepth == jsxBraceDepth.back() + 1` is `0 == 1` — **false**. So it falls through to `--braceDepth` making it -1, and does NOT pop the mode. That's the bug — the condition is off by one.

The `{` in JSXTag mode never incremented `braceDepth` (it was handled before entering JS mode). So when we enter JS, `braceDepth` is still 0 and the closing `}` should trigger when `braceDepth == 0` and there's a pending jsxBraceDepth entry. Fix the condition:

.DESCRIPTION

.PARAMETER Binary
    Path to the yggdrasil binary. Defaults to bin\yggdrasil.exe relative to repo root.

.PARAMETER Filter

#>
param(
    [string]$Binary = "",
    [string]$Filter = "*"
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$RepoRoot    = Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..\..") | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Path
$FixturesDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot "tests\fixtures"

if ($Binary -eq "") {
    $Binary = Join-Path $RepoRoot "bin\yggdrasil.exe"
}

if (-not (Test-Path $Binary)) {
    Write-Error "Binary not found: $Binary`nBuild first with: .\build.ps1"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ANSI colour helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Green  { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Green  -NoNewline }
function Red    { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Red    -NoNewline }
function Yellow { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Yellow -NoNewline }
function Cyan   { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Cyan   -NoNewline }
function Nl     { Write-Host "" }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Diff helper — show first divergence
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Show-Diff {
    param([string]$Expected, [string]$Actual)
    $expLines = $Expected -split "`n"
    $actLines = $Actual   -split "`n"
    $max = [Math]::Max($expLines.Count, $actLines.Count)
    $shown = 0
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $max -and $shown -lt 8; $i++) {
        $e = if ($i -lt $expLines.Count) { $expLines[$i] } else { "<missing>" }
        $a = if ($i -lt $actLines.Count) { $actLines[$i] } else { "<missing>" }
        if ($e -ne $a) {
            Yellow "    line $($i+1):`n"; Nl
            Green  "      expected: $e"; Nl
            Red    "      actual  : $a"; Nl
            $shown++
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Collect fixtures
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$jsxFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $FixturesDir -Filter "$Filter.jsx" |
            Where-Object { $_.Name -notmatch "^err_" -or $_.Name -match "^err_" } |
            Sort-Object Name

$pass = 0
$fail = 0
$skip = 0

Write-Host ""
Cyan "=== Yggdrasil Fixture Tests ==="; Nl
Write-Host "  Binary  : $Binary"
Write-Host "  Fixtures: $FixturesDir"
Write-Host "  Filter  : $Filter"
Write-Host ""

foreach ($jsx in $jsxFiles) {
    $base        = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($jsx.FullName)
    $expectedJs  = Join-Path $FixturesDir "$base.expected.js"
    $expectedExit= Join-Path $FixturesDir "$base.expected_exit"

    # ---- Error-exit test ----
    if (Test-Path $expectedExit) {
        $wantExit = (Get-Content $expectedExit -Raw).Trim()
        $output   = & $Binary $jsx.FullName 2>&1
        $gotExit  = $LASTEXITCODE
        if ([string]$gotExit -eq $wantExit) {
            Green "  PASS"; Write-Host " [exit=$gotExit] $($jsx.Name)"
            $pass++
        } else {
            Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " [exit=$gotExit, want=$wantExit] $($jsx.Name)"
            $fail++
        }
        continue
    }

    # ---- Output comparison test ----
    if (-not (Test-Path $expectedJs)) {
        Yellow "  SKIP"; Write-Host " (no .expected.js) $($jsx.Name)"
        $skip++
        continue
    }

    $expected = (Get-Content $expectedJs -Raw).Replace("`r`n", "`n").TrimEnd()
    $actual   = (& $Binary $jsx.FullName 2>&1 | Out-String).Replace("`r`n", "`n").TrimEnd()
    $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

    if ($exitCode -ne 0) {
        Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " [exit=$exitCode] $($jsx.Name)"
        Write-Host "    stderr: $actual"
        $fail++
        continue
    }

    if ($actual -eq $expected) {
        Green "  PASS"; Write-Host " $($jsx.Name)"
        $pass++
    } else {
        Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " $($jsx.Name)"
        Show-Diff $expected $actual
        $fail++
    }
}

Write-Host ""
Cyan "Results: "; Nl
Green  "  $pass passed"; Nl
if ($fail -gt 0)  { Red    "  $fail failed"; Nl }
if ($skip -gt 0)  { Yellow "  $skip skipped"; Nl }
Write-Host ""

if ($fail -gt 0) { exit 1 } else { exit 0 }

content.text: Exit code is 1 in bash. The PowerShell runner is getting -1 because `$LASTEXITCODE` isn't set correctly when the process throws a native error and is caught by the try/catch. The fix: capture exit code *before* the try/catch affects it, or use a different approach for the exit-code test — run the process and check `$LASTEXITCODE` without catching:

The issue: when stderr output from a native exe is redirected via `2>&1` in PS 5.1, each stderr line becomes an `ErrorRecord`. The `try/catch` catches the exception thrown by the ErrorRecord, but `$LASTEXITCODE` is only set to the actual process exit code after the process completes — but in PS 5.1, a caught `NativeCommandError` resets `$LASTEXITCODE` to the internal error code (-1). The fix: don't redirect stderr at all for exit-code tests, just suppress the output:

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Fixture test runner for Yggdrasil.

.DESCRIPTION
    Two fixture conventions are supported:
      *.jsx + *.expected.js   — transpiler output must equal the .expected.js file
      *.jsx + *.expected_exit — transpiler must exit with the code in that file (error tests)

.PARAMETER Binary
    Path to the yggdrasil binary. Defaults to bin\yggdrasil.exe relative to repo root.

.PARAMETER Filter
    Optional glob filter on fixture base names, e.g. "01_*" or "err_*".
#>
param(
    [string]$Binary = "",
    [string]$Filter = "*"
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$RepoRoot    = Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..\..") | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Path
$FixturesDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot "tests\fixtures"

if ($Binary -eq "") {
    $Binary = Join-Path $RepoRoot "bin\yggdrasil.exe"
}

if (-not (Test-Path $Binary)) {
    Write-Error "Binary not found: $Binary`nBuild first with: .\build.ps1"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ANSI colour helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Green  { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Green  -NoNewline }
function Red    { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Red    -NoNewline }
function Yellow { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Yellow -NoNewline }
function Cyan   { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Cyan   -NoNewline }
function Nl     { Write-Host "" }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Diff helper — show first divergence
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Show-Diff {
    param([string]$Expected, [string]$Actual)
    $expLines = $Expected -split "`n"
    $actLines = $Actual   -split "`n"
    $max = [Math]::Max($expLines.Count, $actLines.Count)
    $shown = 0
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $max -and $shown -lt 8; $i++) {
        $e = if ($i -lt $expLines.Count) { $expLines[$i] } else { "<missing>" }
        $a = if ($i -lt $actLines.Count) { $actLines[$i] } else { "<missing>" }
        if ($e -ne $a) {
            Yellow "    line $($i+1):`n"; Nl
            Green  "      expected: $e"; Nl
            Red    "      actual  : $a"; Nl
            $shown++
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Collect fixtures
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$jsxFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $FixturesDir -Filter "$Filter.jsx" |
            Where-Object { $_.Name -notmatch "^err_" -or $_.Name -match "^err_" } |
            Sort-Object Name

$pass = 0
$fail = 0
$skip = 0

Write-Host ""
Cyan "=== Yggdrasil Fixture Tests ==="; Nl
Write-Host "  Binary  : $Binary"
Write-Host "  Fixtures: $FixturesDir"
Write-Host "  Filter  : $Filter"
Write-Host ""

foreach ($jsx in $jsxFiles) {
    $base        = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($jsx.FullName)
    $expectedJs  = Join-Path $FixturesDir "$base.expected.js"
    $expectedExit= Join-Path $FixturesDir "$base.expected_exit"

    # ---- Error-exit test ----
    if (Test-Path $expectedExit) {
        $wantExit = (Get-Content $expectedExit -Raw).Trim()
        try {
            $null = & $Binary $jsx.FullName 2>&1
        } catch { $null = $_ }
        $gotExit  = $LASTEXITCODE
        if ([string]$gotExit -eq $wantExit) {
            Green "  PASS"; Write-Host " [exit=$gotExit] $($jsx.Name)"
            $pass++
        } else {
            Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " [exit=$gotExit, want=$wantExit] $($jsx.Name)"
            $fail++
        }
        continue
    }

    # ---- Output comparison test ----
    if (-not (Test-Path $expectedJs)) {
        Yellow "  SKIP"; Write-Host " (no .expected.js) $($jsx.Name)"
        $skip++
        continue
    }

    $expected = (Get-Content $expectedJs -Raw).Replace("`r`n", "`n").TrimEnd()
    try   { $actual = (& $Binary $jsx.FullName 2>&1 | Out-String).Replace("`r`n", "`n").TrimEnd() }
    catch { $actual = ($_.ToString()).Replace("`r`n", "`n").TrimEnd() }
    $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

    if ($exitCode -ne 0) {
        Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " [exit=$exitCode] $($jsx.Name)"
        Write-Host "    stderr: $actual"
        $fail++
        continue
    }

    if ($actual -eq $expected) {
        Green "  PASS"; Write-Host " $($jsx.Name)"
        $pass++
    } else {
        Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " $($jsx.Name)"
        Show-Diff $expected $actual
        $fail++
    }
}

Write-Host ""
Cyan "Results: "; Nl
Green  "  $pass passed"; Nl
if ($fail -gt 0)  { Red    "  $fail failed"; Nl }
if ($skip -gt 0)  { Yellow "  $skip skipped"; Nl }
Write-Host ""

if ($fail -gt 0) { exit 1 } else { exit 0 }

content.text:
**32/32 passing.** Here's a summary of everything fixed in this session:

| Root cause | Fix |
|---|---|
| Lexer mode stack never pushed during tokenisation | Rewrote `tokenize()` to self-manage `JSXTag`/`JSXChildren` modes; push `JSXTag` after emitting `JSXLess` in JS mode |
| `/>` scanned as two tokens (`/` + `>`) | Fixed brace-depth tracking so `}` in JS-inside-JSX correctly pops back to `JSXTag`, letting `/>` be seen in JSXTag mode |
| JSX after `?` (ternary) not recognised | Added `QuestionMark` to `jsxAllowed()` |
| Destructured params `({ name })` parsed as `ObjectExpr` | Arrow `(` handler now fast-paths to `parseParam()` when it sees `{`/`[`/`...` |
| `{ name }` emitted as `{ name: name }` | Param stored as raw string via `consumeDestructure`, re-emitted verbatim |
| `[ count, setCount ]` had extra spaces | `consumeDestructure` uses spaces only for `{` patterns, not `[` |
| `export { result }` emitted as `{ result: result }` | Added named-specifier branch to `parseExportDecl` + `genExportNamedDecl` |
| `export default Greeting` missing `;` | `genExportDefaultDecl` adds `;` for non-function declarations |
| `await` not parsed | Added `KW_await` to `parseUnaryExpr` |
| `var [a, b] =` rejected | `parseVarDecl` now calls `consumeDestructure` for `[` patterns |
| Error fixtures crashing PS `$LASTEXITCODE` | Exit-code tests run via `cmd /c ... 2>nul` to avoid PS 5.1 `NativeCommandError` |

time for stage 2/II

MVP Stage 2 — "Solid Tool"
After your basic transpiler works on single files, Stage 2 is about making it robust, usable, and fast without turning it into Babel.
1. Error Recovery & Diagnostics

    Don't crash on first error — resynchronize and report multiple errors per file
    Track source locations in AST nodes (line/column) for precise error pointing even without source maps
    Contextual error messages — "Expected > but found } — did you forget to close an attribute?"

2. Complete JSX Spec Coverage

    Member expression tags: <My.Component />, <context.Provider />
    Namespace tags: <svg:circle /> (if you care about SVG/mathML)
    Spread children: {...items} (rare but valid)
    Whitespace normalization in JSXText — collapse rules differ from HTML
    Comments inside JSX: {/* this */} properly stripped or preserved
    Boolean attributes: <input disabled /> → disabled: true

3. Configurable Output (via config.json or cmdline args)

    Pragma switching: React.createElement vs h() (Preact) vs _jsx (React 17+ automatic runtime)
    Development vs production flags: __source and __self props for React dev warnings
    JSX runtime import injection (React 17+ style: import { jsx } from 'react/jsx-runtime')

4. Performance & Architecture

    Arena allocator for AST nodes instead of individual new/delete or heavy smart pointer churn
    Zero-copy lexer — slice strings from source buffer instead of allocating
    Streaming/batch mode — transpile entire directories, not just stdin/single file
    CLI with flags: --pragma, --out-dir, --watch

5. Edge Case Hardening

    Unicode identifiers in tag names and attributes
    Complex expressions in attributes: <div attr={foo.bar[baz]()} />
    Nested ternaries with JSX: cond ? <A /> : <B /> (parser precedence handling)
    Adjacent JSX elements in expressions: (<></>) fragments wrapping siblings

Stage 2 Time Estimate
+2–3 weeks on top of MVP.

Perfect. Now let me create a comprehensive summary document:

---

## **Yggdrasil JSX Transpiler – Complete Codebase Analysis**

### **Overview**
Yggdrasil is a C++17 JSX-to-JavaScript transpiler implementing:
- **Lexer**: Context-aware tokenization with JSX mode stack
- **Parser**: Recursive-descent with JSX branches
- **CodeGen**: AST walk that lowers JSX to `React.createElement()` calls
- **Error Handling**: Three exception types with line/col diagnostics
- **CLI**: Simple `-o` output flag support

---

## **1. Header Files – Type Definitions & Function Signatures**

### **include/token.h** (54 lines)
Defines every token the lexer can produce:

**Token Types:**
- **Literals**: Number, String, TemplateString, Identifier, Regex
- **Keywords** (28): return, import, export, default, function, const, let, var, from, as, if, else, for, while, do, new, typeof, void, delete, in, instanceof, class, extends, this, super, null, true, false, async, await
- **Operators & Punctuation** (36): LParen, RParen, LBrace, RBrace, LBracket, RBracket, Semicolon, Colon, Comma, Dot, DotDotDot, QuestionMark, Arrow (=>), Equals, comparison operators (==, ===, !=, !==), compound assignments (+=, -=, *=, /=, %=), logical (&&, ||, ??), bitwise operators (&, |, ^, ~, <<, >>, >>>), arithmetic (+, -, *, /, %), unary (!)
- **JSX-specific** (6): JSXLess, JSXGreater, JSXSlashGreater, JSXLessSlash, JSXText, JSXString
- **Meta**: EndOfFile, Unknown

**Struct: Token**
```
TokenKind   kind
std::string value      // token content
int         line       // 1-based line number
int         col        // 1-based column number
```

---

### **include/ast.h** (122 lines)
Unified AST using single `Node` struct with discriminated union via `kind` field.

**Node Kinds** (66 total):
- **Program & Module**: Program, ImportDecl, ExportDefaultDecl, ExportNamedDecl
- **Statements**: FunctionDecl, BlockStmt, ReturnStmt, ExprStmt, IfStmt, ForStmt, WhileStmt, VarDecl, VarDeclarator
- **Expressions**: Identifier, NumericLiteral, StringLiteral, TemplateLiteral, BoolLiteral, NullLiteral, BinaryExpr, UnaryExpr, LogicalExpr, AssignExpr, CallExpr, MemberExpr, NewExpr, ConditionalExpr, SpreadElement, ArrayExpr, ObjectExpr, ObjectProperty, SequenceExpr, ArrowFunctionExpr
- **JSX** (11): JSXElement, JSXFragment, JSXOpeningElement, JSXClosingElement, JSXSelfClosingElement, JSXAttribute, JSXSpreadAttribute, JSXExpressionContainer, JSXText, JSXIdentifier, JSXMemberExpr

**Node Struct** (flat design, 111 lines of definition):
```cpp
struct Node {
    NodeKind            kind;
    int                 line = 0;
    int                 col  = 0;
    
    // Payload fields (unused are default-initialised):
    std::string         name;               // identifiers, tag names, operators
    std::string         value;              // literals
    bool                boolVal = false;
    
    NodeList            children;           // generic child list
    NodeList            params;             // function params
    NodeList            body;               // block body
    
    // Single-child pointers
    NodePtr             init;               // var declarator init / for-init
    NodePtr             test;               // if/for/while condition
    NodePtr             update;             // for-update
    NodePtr             consequent;         // if true branch
    NodePtr             alternate;          // if false branch / else
    
    NodePtr             callee;             // CallExpr function
    NodeList            arguments;          // CallExpr args
    
    NodePtr             object;             // MemberExpr/JSXMemberExpr object
    NodePtr             property;           // MemberExpr property
    bool                computed = false;   // [prop] vs .prop
    
    NodeList            declarations;       // VarDecl list
    NodePtr             declaration;        // ExportDefaultDecl single decl
    
    NodeList            specifiers;         // ImportDecl/ExportDecl imports
    std::string         source;             // ImportDecl module path
    
    // JSX fields
    NodeList            attributes;         // JSXElement attributes
    NodePtr             openingElement;     // JSXElement open tag
    NodePtr             closingElement;     // JSXElement close tag
    bool                selfClosing = false;
    
    NodePtr             expression;         // JSXExpressionContainer / ExprStmt expr
    std::string         varKind;            // "const" | "let" | "var"
    bool                async_ = false;
    
    // Template literals
    NodeList            quasis;             // TemplateLiteral cooked strings
    NodeList            exprs;              // TemplateLiteral expressions
};

// Factory
inline NodePtr makeNode(NodeKind k, int line = 0, int col = 0)
    -> creates and returns unique_ptr<Node> with kind/line/col set
```

**Type Aliases:**
```cpp
using NodePtr  = std::unique_ptr<Node>
using NodeList = std::vector<NodePtr>
```

---

### **include/lexer.h** (61 lines)

**Enum: LexMode**
```
JS           // normal JavaScript
JSXTag       // inside <Tag ...> or </Tag>
JSXChildren  // between > ... < (text / expression containers)
```

**Class: Lexer**
```cpp
// Construction
explicit Lexer(std::string source)

// Public API
std::vector<Token> tokenize()  // returns vector of all tokens

// Mode management
void pushMode(LexMode m)
void popMode()

// Private implementation
private:
    std::string          src_;
    size_t               pos_ = 0;
    int                  line_ = 1;
    int                  col_ = 1;
    TokenKind            lastKind_ = TokenKind::EndOfFile;
    std::vector<LexMode> modeStack_;
    
    LexMode              currentMode() const
    
    // Char helpers
    char                 peek(int offset = 0) const
    char                 advance()
    bool                 atEnd() const
    void                 skipWhitespaceAndComments()
    
    // JS scanners
    Token                scanNumber()
    Token                scanString(char quote)
    Token                scanTemplate()
    Token                scanIdentifierOrKeyword()
    Token                scanRegex(int tline, int tcol)
    Token                scanPunctuation()
    
    // JSX scanners
    Token                scanJSXText()
    Token                scanJSXString(char quote)
    
    // Helpers
    bool                 regexAllowed() const        // context-sensitive
    bool                 jsxAllowed() const          // context-sensitive
    static TokenKind     keywordKind(const std::string& w)
    Token                makeToken(TokenKind k, std::string v, int l, int c) const
```

**Key Behavior:**
- Mode stack drives tokenization logic
- JSX mode entered on `<` when `jsxAllowed()` true
- Brace depth tracking within JSX expressions via parallel `jsxBraceDepth` stack
- Whitespace preserved in JSXChildren mode (raw text handling)

---

### **include/parser.h** (95 lines)

**Class: Parser** (recursive-descent)
```cpp
// Construction
explicit Parser(std::vector<Token> tokens)

// Entry point
NodePtr parse()  // returns Program node

// Private implementation
private:
    std::vector<Token> tokens_;
    size_t             pos_ = 0;
    
    // Token stream
    const Token&       peek(int offset = 0) const
    const Token&       advance()
    bool               check(TokenKind k) const
    bool               match(TokenKind k)
    const Token&       expect(TokenKind k, const std::string& msg)
    bool               atEnd() const

    // Statements (9)
    NodePtr            parseStatement()
    NodePtr            parseImportDecl()
    NodePtr            parseExportDecl()
    NodePtr            parseFunctionDecl(bool async_ = false)
    NodePtr            parseBlockStmt()
    NodePtr            parseReturnStmt()
    NodePtr            parseIfStmt()

    NodePtr            parseWhileStmt()
    NodePtr            parseVarDecl()
    NodePtr            parseExprStmt()
    
    // Expressions (14 precedence levels)
    NodePtr            parseExpr()
    NodePtr            parseAssignExpr()
    NodePtr            parseConditionalExpr()
    NodePtr            parseLogicalOrExpr()         // ||, ??
    NodePtr            parseLogicalAndExpr()        // &&
    NodePtr            parseBitwiseOrExpr()         // |
    NodePtr            parseBitwiseXorExpr()        // ^
    NodePtr            parseBitwiseAndExpr()        // &
    NodePtr            parseEqualityExpr()          // ==, !=, ===, !==
    NodePtr            parseRelationalExpr()        // <, >, <=, >=, in, instanceof
    NodePtr            parseShiftExpr()             // <<, >>, >>>
    NodePtr            parseAdditiveExpr()          // +, -
    NodePtr            parseMultiplicativeExpr()    // *, /, %
    NodePtr            parseUnaryExpr()             // !, -, +, ~, typeof, void, delete, await
    NodePtr            parseUpdateExpr()            // ++, --
    NodePtr            parseCallMemberExpr()        // call, member access, computed
    NodePtr            parsePrimaryExpr()           // literals, identifiers, arrow
    
    // Parameters
    NodePtr            parseParam()  // simple, rest, destructure
    std::string        consumeDestructure(TokenKind open, TokenKind close, char openCh, char closeCh)
    
    // Literals
    NodePtr            parseArrowFunction(NodePtr firstParam)
    NodePtr            parseFunctionExpr(bool async_)
    NodePtr            parseArrayExpr()
    NodePtr            parseObjectExpr()
    NodePtr            parseTemplateLiteral()
    
    // JSX (9 methods)
    NodePtr            parseJSXElement()
```

## **4. Current Limitations & Design Decisions**

### **Known Limitations:**

1. **Parameter Destructuring:**
   - Patterns stored as raw text; no semantic understanding of nested destructure
   - Default values appended to parameter name string

2. **JSX Attribute Names:**
   - Only simple identifiers supported (not `data-x` or other dash-separated names)
   - Comment notes this as MVP limitation

3. **Template Literals:**
   - Entire template (raw content with `${}`) stored in single `value` field
   - Lexer tracks nesting depth but parser doesn't parse expressions inside templates

4. **Regex Disambiguation:**
   - Context-sensitive via `lastKind_` heuristic (not perfect but covers most cases)

5. **Error Recovery:**
   - Single-error parse model; first error throws, stops parsing
   - No multi-error collection or recovery strategies

6. **Comments:**
   - Lexer strips all comments (no preservation for output)

7. **Source Maps:**
   - Line/col tracked in tokens and AST but no source map generation

8. **Indentation:**
   - Fixed 2-space indent (configurable in CodeGen constructor, but no CLI flag)

### **Design Decisions:**

1. **Flat Node Structure:**
   - Single `Node` struct with union-like field layout (all fields present, unused zeroed)
   - Avoids deep inheritance hierarchies and virtual dispatch overhead
   - Trade-off: more memory per node, but simpler to work with

2. **Destructuring as Raw Text:**
   - Parameters/var patterns captured verbatim from token stream
   - Allows re-emission without full semantic parsing of nested structures

3. **JSX Mode Stack:**
   - Lexer self-manages mode via push/pop on specific tokens
   - Enables context-aware tokenization (e.g., `<` is JSXLess in expression context, Less elsewhere)

4. **Brace Depth Tracking:**
   - Parallel `jsxBraceDepth` stack allows lexer to close JSX expressions at correct `}`
   - Handles nested braces inside JSX expression containers

5. **No Pragma System:**
   - No directive comments (like `/* @jsx React.createElement */`) for alternate render functions
   - Always emits `React.createElement()`

6. **String Escaping in CodeGen:**
   - JSXText collapsed to single spaces; inline spacing preserved (e.g., `"Hello "` kept)
   - Trailing space on newline-terminated text is trimmed

## **4. Current Limitations & Design Decisions**

### **Known Limitations:**

1. **Parameter Destructuring:**
   - Patterns stored as raw text; no semantic understanding of nested destructure
   - Default values appended to parameter name string

2. **JSX Attribute Names:**
   - Only simple identifiers supported (not `data-x` or other dash-separated names)
   - Comment notes this as MVP limitation

3. **Template Literals:**
   - Entire template (raw content with `${}`) stored in single `value` field
   - Lexer tracks nesting depth but parser doesn't parse expressions inside templates

4. **Regex Disambiguation:**
   - Context-sensitive via `lastKind_` heuristic (not perfect but covers most cases)

5. **Error Recovery:**
   - Single-error parse model; first error throws, stops parsing
   - No multi-error collection or recovery strategies

6. **Comments:**
   - Lexer strips all comments (no preservation for output)

7. **Source Maps:**
   - Line/col tracked in tokens and AST but no source map generation

8. **Indentation:**
   - Fixed 2-space indent (configurable in CodeGen constructor, but no CLI flag)

### **Design Decisions:**

1. **Flat Node Structure:**
   - Single `Node` struct with union-like field layout (all fields present, unused zeroed)
   - Avoids deep inheritance hierarchies and virtual dispatch overhead
   - Trade-off: more memory per node, but simpler to work with

2. **Destructuring as Raw Text:**
   - Parameters/var patterns captured verbatim from token stream
   - Allows re-emission without full semantic parsing of nested structures

3. **JSX Mode Stack:**
   - Lexer self-manages mode via push/pop on specific tokens
   - Enables context-aware tokenization (e.g., `<` is JSXLess in expression context, Less elsewhere)

4. **Brace Depth Tracking:**
   - Parallel `jsxBraceDepth` stack allows lexer to close JSX expressions at correct `}`
   - Handles nested braces inside JSX expression containers

5. **No Pragma System:**
   - No directive comments (like `/* @jsx React.createElement */`) for alternate render functions
   - Always emits `React.createElement()`

6. **String Escaping in CodeGen:**
   - JSXText collapsed to single spaces; inline spacing preserved (e.g., `"Hello "` kept)
   - Trailing space on newline-terminated text is trimmed

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Fixture test runner for Yggdrasil.

.DESCRIPTION
    Two fixture conventions are supported:
      *.jsx + *.expected.js   — transpiler output must equal the .expected.js file
      *.jsx + *.expected_exit — transpiler must exit with the code in that file (error tests)

.PARAMETER Binary
    Path to the yggdrasil binary. Defaults to bin\yggdrasil.exe relative to repo root.

.PARAMETER Filter
    Optional glob filter on fixture base names, e.g. "01_*" or "err_*".
#>
param(
    [string]$Binary = "",
    [string]$Filter = "*"
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$RepoRoot    = Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..\..") | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Path
$FixturesDir = Join-Path $RepoRoot "tests\fixtures"

if ($Binary -eq "") {
    $Binary = Join-Path $RepoRoot "bin\yggdrasil.exe"
}

if (-not (Test-Path $Binary)) {
    Write-Error "Binary not found: $Binary`nBuild first with: .\build.ps1"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# ANSI colour helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Green  { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Green  -NoNewline }
function Red    { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Red    -NoNewline }
function Yellow { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Yellow -NoNewline }
function Cyan   { param($s) Write-Host $s -ForegroundColor Cyan   -NoNewline }
function Nl     { Write-Host "" }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Diff helper — show first divergence
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function Show-Diff {
    param([string]$Expected, [string]$Actual)
    $expLines = $Expected -split "`n"
    $actLines = $Actual   -split "`n"
    $max = [Math]::Max($expLines.Count, $actLines.Count)
    $shown = 0
    for ($i = 0; $i -lt $max -and $shown -lt 8; $i++) {
        $e = if ($i -lt $expLines.Count) { $expLines[$i] } else { "<missing>" }
        $a = if ($i -lt $actLines.Count) { $actLines[$i] } else { "<missing>" }
        if ($e -ne $a) {
            Yellow "    line $($i+1):`n"; Nl
            Green  "      expected: $e"; Nl
            Red    "      actual  : $a"; Nl
            $shown++
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Collect fixtures
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
$jsxFiles = Get-ChildItem -Path $FixturesDir -Filter "$Filter.jsx" |
            Where-Object { $_.Name -notmatch "^err_" -or $_.Name -match "^err_" } |
            Sort-Object Name

$pass = 0
$fail = 0
$skip = 0

Write-Host ""
Cyan "=== Yggdrasil Fixture Tests ==="; Nl
Write-Host "  Binary  : $Binary"
Write-Host "  Fixtures: $FixturesDir"
Write-Host "  Filter  : $Filter"
Write-Host ""

foreach ($jsx in $jsxFiles) {
    $base        = [IO.Path]::GetFileNameWithoutExtension($jsx.FullName)
    $expectedJs  = Join-Path $FixturesDir "$base.expected.js"
    $expectedExit= Join-Path $FixturesDir "$base.expected_exit"

    # ---- Error-exit test ----
    if (Test-Path $expectedExit) {
        $wantExit = (Get-Content $expectedExit -Raw).Trim()
        # Redirect stdout+stderr to null so PS 5.1 doesn't wrap stderr lines
        # in ErrorRecords (which corrupt $LASTEXITCODE via NativeCommandError).
        $null = cmd /c "`"$Binary`" `"$($jsx.FullName)`"" "2>nul"
        $gotExit  = $LASTEXITCODE
        if ([string]$gotExit -eq $wantExit) {
            Green "  PASS"; Write-Host " [exit=$gotExit] $($jsx.Name)"
            $pass++
        } else {
            Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " [exit=$gotExit, want=$wantExit] $($jsx.Name)"
            $fail++
        }
        continue
    }

    # ---- Output comparison test ----
    if (-not (Test-Path $expectedJs)) {
        Yellow "  SKIP"; Write-Host " (no .expected.js) $($jsx.Name)"
        $skip++
        continue
    }

    $expected = (Get-Content $expectedJs -Raw).Replace("`r`n", "`n").TrimEnd()
    try   { $actual = (& $Binary $jsx.FullName 2>&1 | Out-String).Replace("`r`n", "`n").TrimEnd() }
    catch { $actual = ($_.ToString()).Replace("`r`n", "`n").TrimEnd() }
    $exitCode = $LASTEXITCODE

    if ($exitCode -ne 0) {
        Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " [exit=$exitCode] $($jsx.Name)"
        Write-Host "    stderr: $actual"
        $fail++
        continue
    }

    if ($actual -eq $expected) {
        Green "  PASS"; Write-Host " $($jsx.Name)"
        $pass++
    } else {
        Red   "  FAIL"; Write-Host " $($jsx.Name)"
        Show-Diff $expected $actual
        $fail++
    }
}

Write-Host ""
Cyan "Results: "; Nl
Green  "  $pass passed"; Nl
if ($fail -gt 0)  { Red    "  $fail failed"; Nl }
if ($skip -gt 0)  { Yellow "  $skip skipped"; Nl }
Write-Host ""

if ($fail -gt 0) { exit 1 } else { exit 0 }

# =============================================================================
# Yggdrasil — JSX Transpiler
# Compiler: clang++ (C++17)
# Cross-platform: Windows (cmd/nmake-style) and Unix (bash)
# =============================================================================

CXX      := clang++
CXXFLAGS := -std=c++17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Iinclude
LDFLAGS  :=

# Directories
SRC_DIR   := src
INC_DIR   := include
BUILD_DIR := build
BIN_DIR   := bin

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# OS detection
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ifeq ($(OS),Windows_NT)
    PLATFORM      := windows
    TARGET        := $(BIN_DIR)/yggdrasil.exe
    RM_RF         := rmdir /s /q
    MKDIR         = if not exist "$@" mkdir "$@"
    DEVNULL       := nul
    # PowerShell available everywhere on modern Windows
    TEST_CMD      := powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass \
                     -File tests\runner\run_tests.ps1 -Binary $(TARGET)
    PATHSEP       := \\
else
    UNAME := $(shell uname -s)
    PLATFORM      := unix
    TARGET        := $(BIN_DIR)/yggdrasil
    RM_RF         := rm -rf
    MKDIR         = mkdir -p "$@"
    DEVNULL       := /dev/null
    TEST_CMD       = @pass=0; fail=0; \
        for jsx in tests/fixtures/*.jsx; do \
            base=$${jsx%.jsx}; \
            expected=$${base}.expected.js; \
            [ -f "$$expected" ] || continue; \
            actual=$$($(TARGET) "$$jsx" 2>&1); \
            exp=$$(cat "$$expected"); \
            if [ "$$actual" = "$$exp" ]; then \
                printf '  \033[32mPASS\033[0m %s\n' "$$jsx"; pass=$$((pass+1)); \
            else \
                printf '  \033[31mFAIL\033[0m %s\n' "$$jsx"; \
                printf '  --- expected ---\n'; echo "$$exp"; \
                printf '  --- actual   ---\n'; echo "$$actual"; \
                fail=$$((fail+1)); \
            fi; \
        done; \
        printf 'Results: %d passed, %d failed\n' "$$pass" "$$fail"; \
        [ $$fail -eq 0 ]
    PATHSEP       := /
endif

# Collect all .cpp sources
SRCS := $(wildcard $(SRC_DIR)/*.cpp)
OBJS := $(patsubst $(SRC_DIR)/%.cpp,$(BUILD_DIR)/%.o,$(SRCS))

# Header dependencies (all headers in include/)
HEADERS := $(wildcard $(INC_DIR)/*.h)

# =============================================================================
# Targets
# =============================================================================

.PHONY: all clean release debug test help

all: $(TARGET)

# Link
$(TARGET): $(OBJS) | $(BIN_DIR)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) $(LDFLAGS) -o $@ $^
	@echo "Built: $@"

# Compile each .cpp -> .o
$(BUILD_DIR)/%.o: $(SRC_DIR)/%.cpp $(HEADERS) | $(BUILD_DIR)
	$(CXX) $(CXXFLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

# Create output directories
$(BUILD_DIR):
	$(MKDIR)

$(BIN_DIR):
	$(MKDIR)

# Debug build (no optimisation, debug symbols, sanitisers)
debug: CXXFLAGS += -g -O0 -DDEBUG -fsanitize=address,undefined
debug: LDFLAGS  += -fsanitize=address,undefined
debug: $(TARGET)

# Release build (optimised)
release: CXXFLAGS += -O2 -DNDEBUG
release: $(TARGET)

# Run test fixtures
test: $(TARGET)
	$(TEST_CMD)

# Clean build artefacts
clean:
ifeq ($(PLATFORM),windows)
	-$(RM_RF) $(BUILD_DIR) 2>$(DEVNULL)
	-$(RM_RF) $(BIN_DIR)   2>$(DEVNULL)
else
	$(RM_RF) $(BUILD_DIR) $(BIN_DIR)
endif

help:
	@echo "Targets:"
	@echo "  all      Build the transpiler (default)"
	@echo "  debug    Build with debug symbols and sanitisers"
	@echo "  release  Build optimised"
	@echo "  test     Run fixture tests"
	@echo "  clean    Remove build artefacts"
	@echo ""
	@echo "Platform: $(PLATFORM)"
	@echo "Target  : $(TARGET)"
